source: claude-agent-sdk 0.2.181 in-process MCP server path: Query._handle_sdk_mcp_request, SdkMcpBridge, mcp 2.3.0 lowlevel Server, the create_sdk_mcp_server run_tool handler, jsonschema 4.26.0 with referencing 0.37. Answers use the OK / ERR / RPCERR text format of python_schema.json.
assumptions: Each case ran with sys.setrecursionlimit(limit) set at module level before asyncio.run, so jsonschema.validate still sits at absolute frame depth 17 and the budget below it is limit less 17.

The schema is a draft 3 object whose c property refers back to the root and whose s property has a type, known or unknown; the argument nests depth objects under c and ends in {"s": 1}. Each level costs four frames, so the limits 1000 to 1009 put the type check of the deepest s at every offset of a level.
An unknown type raises UnknownType through UndefinedTypeCheck, whose __init__ frame stands where the checker function of a known type would, so both boundaries fall at the same depth.

answers is the steady state after a warmup call of the same shape at depth 1, sent twice with identical answers; cold_answers is present only where a fresh process answers differently. depth is the nesting count given to the shape builder; last_ok and first_rec are N and N+1 at the boundary.
